rationale.provenance-auditability: Makes prompts, bindings, outputs, checks, and reviewer decisions persistently auditable.
rationale.org-governance: Integrates policy, change control, audit logging, accountability, and organizational escalation.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Aligns escalation records and transparency with EU AI Act expectations.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Provides citations, constraint-output traces, counterfactuals, and reviewer-facing evidence surfaces.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Recommends tests, linters, license detectors, filters, and logged verification passes.
rationale.lit-review: Rapid review synthesizes surveys, studies, and governance sources.
rationale.framework: Provides reusable capability, control, reporting, and pipeline-integration architecture.
rationale.design-only: Specifies buildable schemas, hooks, thresholds, and logs without implementation.
rationale.steering: Governs prompts, context bindings, retrieval scope, and safeguard activation policies.
rationale.metrics: Defines compliance measurands, thresholds, reporting fields, and reviewer protocols.
rationale.survey-input: Synthesizes practitioner needs for transparency, evidence, acceptance, and workflow fit.
rationale.assistive: Covers human-invoked review comments and suggestion-level SDLC assistance.
rationale.agentic: Covers artifact-level agentic workflows governed through PR and CI gates.
rationale.risk-security: Evaluates mitigations for leakage, adversarial prompts, and unsafe outputs.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focally analyzes prompt overreach and reviewer over-trust requiring escalation.
rationale.risk-ip: Specifies license-attribution checks, provenance, adjudication, and generated-code escalation.
rationale.risk-bias: Treats fairness mitigation, parity thresholds, monitoring, and escalation substantively.
